name: Musketeer: Le Sang des Chevaliers
source:
D'Artagnan is just a regular country girl living alone with her father. Life is poor but peaceful. Yet nothing peaceful lasts. Her home is invaded by monsters and her father died under their attack. D'Artagnan only survived because a red eyed swordsman stepped in in time to save her.

To ensure that she never falls victim and to find the culprit behind the monsters, she enrolled into Chevalier Academy to become a musketeer.

[From [url=http://www.play-asia.com/Musketeer_Le_Sang_des_Chevaliers/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-47el.html]PlayAsia[/url]]
translation:
達達尼昂原本只是與父親相依為命的普通鄉村女孩。生活雖貧窮，卻十分平靜。然而平靜從不長久，魔物闖入她家，父親也死於襲擊。幸好一名紅眼劍士及時出手，達達尼昂才得以生還。

為了不再成為受害者，也為了查出操縱魔物的真兇，她進入騎士學院學習，立志成為火槍手。

[譯自[url=http://www.play-asia.com/Musketeer_Le_Sang_des_Chevaliers/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-47el.html]PlayAsia[/url]]
